overview.heading: An owner’s perspective on every project.
overview.body:
LCH Developments is a Toronto developer and development manager. We invest in and develop our own purpose-built rental communities, and we manage development and construction for owners, institutions, lenders and receivers. We also own and operate Merge Spaces, the coworking hub on Kingston Road that houses our office.

Because we carry our own projects from feasibility to occupancy, we test every decision the same way: can it be financed, can it be built, and will it work once it is operating? Through our affiliated construction manager, Elevate, construction cost and sequencing inform the plan from the start.

process.heading: One accountable team, from feasibility to occupancy.
process.intro: Approvals, design, permits and procurement advance together rather than one after another, and every decision is tested against cost, schedule and how the building will lease and operate.

steps.title: Due diligence and feasibility
steps.body: We review the site, planning context, market and any work already done, then build the development budget, cash flow and schedule that show what the project can achieve and what has to be resolved.

steps.title: Approvals and funding support
steps.body: We set the municipal strategy and manage applications, consultants and agency comments, from rezoning and site plan approval to permits and municipal agreements. We also support financing with lenders and housing programs.

steps.title: Design and preconstruction
steps.body: We test massing, floorplates, unit mix, parking and building systems against rentable area and construction cost. Elevate prices the design, reviews constructability and plans long-lead procurement before drawings are final.

steps.title: Construction and owner oversight
steps.body: Elevate manages tendering, trades, safety, quality and schedule on site. LCH represents the owner, tracking budget and cost to complete, managing changes and reporting progress.

steps.title: Occupancy, closeout and warranty
steps.body: We coordinate occupancy, municipal clearances, turnover, deficiencies and warranty, and stay involved through lease-up, closings or purchaser care where the project needs it.

elevate.heading: Development and construction management, working as one team.
elevate.body:
Elevate Construction Management is LCH’s affiliated construction manager. It builds LCH’s own communities and works for outside owners, lenders and court-appointed receivers on low-, mid- and high-rise residential and mixed-use projects.

Because both teams approach a project as owners would, construction realities shape the plan early. Elevate challenges costs, explores alternatives and sets a realistic schedule before work starts, while LCH keeps the business plan, approvals and reporting on track.
